verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a public API with 120+ actions covering domains, DNS, orders, account settings, aftermarket and reseller functions. Its RESTful v2 reference is versioned with a changelog and backed by a dedicated sandbox with separate keys, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths return 404), stable non-beta status (the REST docs warn behaviors may change without notice), and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Dynadot API lets you programmatically manage domains, account settings, DNS, orders, and other account activities. Our API supports more than 120 actions
Build your account by registering, transferring, and renewing domains through commands. You can even delete and push domains through our API.
The current version of the API is v2.0.0
The Dynadot API Sandbox environment allows you to safely test your API integrations without affecting your live account or real funds
